info.title: DriveCore Backend API
info.description: Initial operational API. Company/branch permissions are enforced server-side. Roles are an engineering baseline pending client approval. Financial calculations, invoices, credit approval, rental extensions and structured inspection evidence are not implemented by this version.

patch.summary: Update user access in a company
patch.description: Requires users.manage and whole-company access. company_id is required in JSON. Only role, branch_id and is_active may change. Self access changes return 409. Company administrators cannot change global roles or activation for multi-company users (409), or manage platform accounts (404). Platform administrators may change global access for multi-company users. Deactivation revokes personal access tokens; existing sessions are denied by active-account middleware. Role assignments are global in this version.
